name: npm/@notionhq/notion-mcp-server
title: Notion
description: Notion workspaces: pages, databases, wikis, and team content through the Notion API.

toolsSummary.name: query-data-source
toolsSummary.description: Query a data source (database) with filters and sorts (API 2025-09-03+).

toolsSummary.name: search
toolsSummary.description: Search pages and data sources across the workspace.

toolsSummary.name: move-page
toolsSummary.description: Move a page to another parent.

toolsSummary.name: create-a-page
toolsSummary.description: Create pages under a parent page or database.

environmentVariables.name: NOTION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Notion integration secret (ntn_…); create at notion.so/profile/integrations

environmentVariables.name: OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Advanced: JSON headers instead of NOTION_TOKEN (Bearer + Notion-Version).
